finalText:
INC-1 is open for the company-wide build-pipeline outage, and I ran it through the current runbook, KB-40. I ignored KB-39 because KB-40 supersedes it.

- **Incident and commander:** I opened INC-1 first. I then paged E-401 Priya Raman, the incident-command engineer on call now, and only her, and made her commander. The page can't be recalled.
- **Linked reports:** T-3101, T-3102, T-3103, T-3104, T-3105, T-3106 and T-3109 are linked to INC-1. All seven describe the same no-runners outage.
- **Left out:** I left out T-3107 (a flaky test) and T-3108 (a local Xcode link failure) because they are separate problems.
- **Severity:** All seven linked reports are now sev1. Deadlines already committed stay as they were. T-3106 and T-3109 had none, so I gave each 16:20 UTC, which is the triage time plus the 60-minute sev1 target.
- **Comms lead:** The comms rotation's E-801 Mia Laurent is on sick leave today. Under the leave rule the backup rotation, comms-secondary, covers, so I named E-803 Elif Demir, who is on call there now.
- **Status update:** I posted the first update at 15:20 UTC. It says "Impact: All company build pipelines are affected… Started: 14:52 UTC. Next update: 15:45 UTC." The 14:52 start is when the earliest report, T-3101, was created.
- **Postmortem:** T-3115 is linked to INC-1 and due 2026-04-08 at 17:00 UTC. That is the 5th business day after today, counting Good Friday (Apr 3) and Easter Monday (Apr 6) as holidays.

The next status update is due by 15:45 UTC.
